LESSON: WRITING 11.4.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: SPELLING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing 11.4.1 Mechanics of writing: Spelling. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it difficult to spell some words correctly? 2. How can we become better at spelling words?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify commonly misspelt words in oral and written contexts,
2. write commonly misspelt words correctly for communication clarity,
3. adopt the skill of writing words clearly and correctly in communication. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES
